newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan to hold elections with or without Islamists.
newsitem.headline: Jordan to hold elections with or without Islamists.

text.p: Jordan has said it would press ahead with parliamentary elections due later this year regardless of whether Islamist candidates stand in the polls.

A government statement carried by the official Petra news agency on Monday night rejected conditions set by the Moslem Brotherhood to revoke its call for an election boycott and accused it of making illogical demands.

"The government has studied the statement of the Moslem Brotherhood with an open heart but it is not persuaded by its justifications," the statement said. "The government believes that this statement is born of an internal crisis in the (Brotherhood) movement."
The Brotherhood, whose Islamic Action Front (IAF) political arm is Jordan's largest opposition party, called last week for a boycott of the elections.
It then said it might reconsider if the government revoked a raft of "interim" laws, issued without being passed through parliament, and made guarantees about political freedoms.

The Islamic Action Front, which initially reacted with caution to the boycott call, is now holding talks with secular opposition parties on the possibility of a coordinated opposition boycott of the elections.
No date has been officially set for the elections but they are scheduled to be held by November.

"The government believes that the (Brotherhood) movement represents an important political element in Jordan. It is keen that all elements be given the chance for just representation and calls on it to review its decision," the statement said.
"At the same time the government affirms that free and fair elections will be held according to the constitutional schedule, with or without the participation of the movement."

It said Brotherhood demands for the cancellations of the interim laws, a particular irritant to the parliamentary opposition, were illogical because the government would have to pass yet more interim laws to cancel out the original ones.
